title: FNVR - Fictions Narratives en Vers de la Renaissance (1490-1600)
notes: FNVR is a Litt&Arts (Grenoble) project building XML-TEI editions of French verse narratives composed or translated 1490-1600, some first modern editions, led by Pascale Mounier; the TEI dataset is openly published on Recherche Data Gouv (DOI 10.57745/SSC5XT). The harvested files (amantDesconforte, chevallier, palamon, rondeaux) match the repo layout of elan/fnvr on the Grenoble GitLab, whose project page is live (200) and matches origin 'ELAN fnvr: amantDesconforte'. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, including retained duplicates; harvested subset).
institution: ELAN / UMR Litt&Arts (CNRS / Universite Grenoble Alpes), dir. Pascale Mounier
